title: Combobox
summary: An autocomplete (type to filter a list) or, with mode="select", a custom select. ARIA combobox with the highlight tracked by aria-activedescendant, so focus stays on the control. Its options are its own option children.

props.name: mode
props.description: autocomplete filters as you type; select is a button that opens the list (type a letter to jump). Prefer the native pk-select on a phone.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value; what the form submits.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: free
props.description: Autocomplete: keep typed text that is not an option, and use it as the value.

props.name: filtering
props.description: client also filters the options here; off leaves filtering to the host, which listens for pk-combo-query and replaces the options.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: The message shown when nothing matches.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-combo-query
events.description: The user typed: the text so far, so a host can fetch more options (with filtering="off" it also replaces the client filter).

a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox: role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant (focus stays on the input or button); Arrow keys open and move, Home and End jump (select mode), Enter picks, Escape closes, Tab closes, letters jump in select mode. The chosen option carries aria-selected and a check mark. Options are 44px tall on a phone; the list opens upward when there is no room below.

examples.title: Autocomplete
examples.html: <pk-combobox label="Variant" placeholder="Type to search"><option value="AC-1001">AC-1001 - Widget 1</option><option value="AC-1002">AC-1002 - Widget 2</option><option value="AC-1003">AC-1003 - Widget 3</option></pk-combobox>

examples.title: Custom select
examples.html: <pk-combobox mode="select" label="Channel" placeholder="Choose a channel" value="market"><option value="web">Web</option><option value="market">Market</option><option value="live">Live</option><option value="other" disabled>Poshmark (unavailable)</option></pk-combobox>
